title: Microburst census sprint notes — tracing + cost telemetry
content:
Meeting: Microburst Census sprint sync (weekly)
Date: 2027-09-29
Attendees: Ava Chen, Marcus Liu, Priya Kapoor, Diego Ramos, Hannah Park, (joined late) Samir Desai
Location: #observability standup + quick demo in call
Goal: consolidate microburst tracing sampling results, decide dashboard rollout for microburst metrics, and assign next experiments for cost telemetry correlations.

TL;DR
- Microburst sampling prototype is reducing span volume by ~48% for the serving-runtime hot path without losing top-heavy traces. Initial quality check shows <3% loss on canary prompts (see Eval-run-2027-09-27).
- Dashboard draft (microburst-health) is usable; need one more iteration for alert thresholds and a condensed view for on-call.
- Cost telemetry spike on 09-27 at 03:14 UTC is correlated with a short-lived KV-cache invalidation loop; further root cause requires SRE infra trace. JIRA-OBS-1156 opened.

Notes / discussion items
1) Microburst sampling experiment (Priya/Diego)
  - Summary: sampling logic captures 100% of traces with >X latency or >Y error count; applies probabilistic keep to short spans (microbursts).
  - Results: overall span count down ~48% on service 'gen-api-hot' in the canary namespace over 72h.
  - Quality checks: ran prompt set P-tilt-1 and P-tilt-2, human spot checks on 120 traces -> 4 misses where conversation-level context was incomplete. Priya proposes a small tweak: bump deterministic keep for first-2-chunks of a request.
  - Action: Priya to push sampling tweak branch and re-run canary by 2027-10-03. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/842

2) Dashboard workstream (Marcus)
  - New dashboard: microburst-health (draft ID: dash-obs-34). Focused widgets:
    * microburst-rate per service (smoothed 1m/5m)
    * retained-trace-quality (manual eval pass rate)
    * cost-per-span and estimated cost-savings (derived)
    * alert: sudden drop in retained-trace-quality or microburst rate > 75% for 5m
  - Feedback from SRE: need condensed on-call tile with single-line summary and link-to-trace; reduce visuals for mobile.
  - Action: Marcus to produce a simplified on-call panel and add an automated example link to a representative trace for each alert case. Due 2027-10-06.

3) Cost telemetry spike (Hannah)
  - Incident snapshot: 2027-09-27 03:14 UTC — 18% CPU bump on dedicated group 'ded-gpu-3' and token billing anomaly. Initial metric correlation shows elevated span emission rate from gen-api-hot for ~90s.
  - Investigation: Diego replayed trace sampling logs; saw an eviction-induced cache fill pattern (KV-cache invalidation loop) in serving-runtime. Hypothesis: a small mem-leak + GC pattern triggered cache droops -> more re-compute -> more spans.
  - Next steps: SRE infra to run heap/profiler capture for ded-gpu-3 during next repro window; engineering owner: Samir Desai. Filed JIRA-OBS-1156 for infra investigation.

4) Sampling policy rollout plan (Ava)
  - Canary (current): 5% of production traffic, namespace: canary/microburst/sep
  - Stage: expand to 25% if canary quality pass rate > 97% over 72h and no cost regressions.
  - Full rollout: staged per-region with rollback policy if retained-trace-quality drops below 95% or on-call alerts fire.
  - Rollout checklist: update docs (confluence), alerting thresholds (dash-obs-34), canary monitor automation (Jenkins job microburst-canary-01).
  - Action: Ava to update rollout doc and add canary automation ticket by 2027-10-01.

5) Observability backlog grooming (quick hits)
  - Remove old heavy-span dashboard (dash-obs-7) or mark archival: Marcus to propose retention policy.
  - Long-tail: add budget tag to spans emitted by experimental features (so billing owner can filter); ticket JIRA-OBS-1123.
  - Small UX: add trace-link button to all microburst dashboards — Diego will prototype.

Quick wins / experiments to schedule
- Experiment: adaptive microburst threshold — increase keep-prob when trace contains >=2 error spans. Owner: Priya. Estimate: 2d.
- Experiment: prefix-KV sampling — keep 100% of traces that access prefix keys >3 times. Owner: Diego. Estimate: 3d.
- Cost sanity: run cost projection job with sampling reduction factored in; CFO/finance alias watchlist. Owner: Hannah. Estimate: 1d to produce slide.

Open questions
- Are we comfortable with a 3% miss rate on canary prompt set before Stage rollout? (discussion: team generally ok if human review of misses shows non-product-impacting context loss)
- If SRE finds memory leak in GPU nodes, do we pause rollout? Tentatively yes — must be resolved before full rollout.

Decisions made
- Proceed with tweak to keep-first-2-chunks and re-run canary (Priya -> 2027-10-03).
- Add condensed on-call tile to microburst-health dashboard and enable alerting for quality drops >5% (Marcus -> 2027-10-06).

Action items (owner — due)
- Priya Kapoor — push sampling tweak branch and run canary (2027-10-03)
- Marcus Liu — build condensed on-call panel + example trace links on dash-obs-34 (2027-10-06)
- Ava Chen — update rollout doc and create canary automation ticket (2027-10-01)
- Diego Ramos — prototype trace-link UX on dashboard + prefix-KV experiment (2027-10-04)
- Hannah Park — generate cost projection slide and add finance watchers (2027-10-05)
- Samir Desai / SRE — run profiler on ded-gpu-3 when next reproducible window occurs (ASAP)

Notes to self / scratch
- Re-run Eval-run-2027-09-27 with expanded prompt set tomorrow morning; include edge-case long-history prompts.
- Keep an eye on edge-region eu-west-2 where latency is slightly higher — may affect microburst stats.
- Follow up with legal for telemetry retention policy if we change span retention significantly.

Attachments / data pointers
- Eval-run-2027-09-27 (spreadsheet): estimate retained-trace-quality 97.1% (raw)
- dash-obs-34 (draft): please comment in the dashboard doc
- JIRA-OBS-1156: infra-investigate-cache-eviction-loop
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/842 (sampling heuristic prototype)

If anything else crops up, add notes here. We'll review progress in next weekly sync: 2027-10-06.

-- Ava
